title: American Kills First Class, BA Guts Heathrow, and JetBlue Finally Gets a First Class Cabin
summary: American Airlines unveils its swanky new Flagship Suites and sets a hard end date for international first class — while somehow also housing delayed passengers in a hotel with the ceiling ripped open. Plus, British Airways slashes 77 routes from Heathrow, JetBlue finally reveals its long-awaited domestic first class, and United's top status tier proves that loyalty, apparently, has a price tag of five million dollars.
